# Miauterm v0.1.1

This release fixes the `miauterm-cmd` app bridge not being available from a Debian shell.

- Start the command API with the Android app so Debian commands can find its connection details before a terminal session starts.
- Keep the API available when the terminal foreground service stops.
- Add a startup regression check for the connection file and local command server.

The release contains signed ARM64 APKs and SHA-256 checksums. Install the release APK on Android 7.0 or newer with an ARM64 processor.
